_how_to: Copy to settings.json (git-ignored) and replace every CHANGE_ME. Flat keys are used in files as {{KEY}} and can be overridden by an env var of the same name. Check with: python3 config.py check
_DEVELOPER_NAMES: Optional, comma-separated: other developers whose ticket comment means the ticket is already taken.
_REVIEWER: Optional: who gets a review DM when a change touches a repo's review_files.
_SCAN_PERMISSION: ask = ask in the terminal before step 0 scans a repo (no terminal = no scan) | always | never

my-app._base_branch: Optional. Default: what step 0 finds (origin/HEAD), else automation.json defaults.base_branch.
my-app._focus_keywords: Optional: words in a ticket title/tags that put it in the 'focus' ranking tiers (e.g. the screens customers complain about most).

test_environment.notes: How to sign in to the test environment, test accounts, storefront/basic-auth password, anything step 2/4 needs. The ONLY place the automation may change anything.

my-app._review_files: Optional: paths/globs whose change triggers one review DM to REVIEWER_* after the draft PR.
